checks: Independent bounded oracle and rejected source mutation; see adjacent model.md#tests.
cost: O(n+m) time and O(m) prefix storage plus returned matches.
description: Exact byte matching with overlaps and explicit empty-pattern boundaries.
forward: For nonempty p return every i with text[i..i+|p|]=p; for empty p return every boundary 0..=|text|.
inverse: The adjacent behavior_complement models excluded input/output pairs in an explicit universe.
reverse_reconstruction retains all compatible inputs; optimization, equality and output projection lose information.
limitations: Finite checks are not universal proof.
